title: The trip savings stopped when she switched banks

life.summary: Support analyst on a salary in London, moved from abroad five years ago, saving spending money for a two-week trip to see her family in February, amounts in pounds

known.fact: Wants GBP 1,200 of spending money for the February trip in the Trip pot by Feb 1
Routine: moves money herself on payday evening, after work, never in the morning
known.source: told Dev, matches 5 months of transfers

known.fact: Routine: her family video-calls on Sunday mornings at 7 (3 PM their time)
Switched banks with the switching service; the switch completed Sep 28

dev_must_notice.what: The Trip pot stopped growing. The GBP 150 on the 1st was a saving rule inside her old bank's app, and the switch on Sep 28 didn't carry it over, so Oct 1 and Nov 1 were skipped. It holds GBP 600 of the GBP 1,200 she wants by Feb 1, and restarting GBP 150 a month from Dec 1 would only reach GBP 900

best_fix.what: This evening, after work, one message with the trace: the rule didn't move with the switch, GBP 600 of 1,200 so far, and the way back on track that fits how she already saves: GBP 200 on each of the three payday evenings left before Feb 1 (Nov 30, Dec 31, Jan 29). Offer a reminder at 6 PM on each of those evenings to move it herself, or a pointer to set up a new saving rule in her new bank's app. Dev doesn't move it.
best_fix.why: Each skipped month makes the catch-up bigger, and she'd otherwise find out in February. She moves money herself on payday evenings, so the catch-up is split across exactly those three evenings and the help is a reminder in that window, not a transfer.

must_not: Remind her at 6 AM when the salary lands or during work; she moves money on payday evening after work
Move money to the Trip pot or set up a saving rule for her
Count the Nov 30 salary as money she has now
Show a progress bar or a percentage for the goal
Blame her for the switch or call it a mistake
Suggest dropping the trip or cutting gifts for her family
assumptions: The UK switching service moves standing orders and direct debits but not saving rules inside the old bank's app
Pay lands on the last working day of the month (Oct 30, Nov 30, Dec 31, Jan 29)
The new current account had GBP 690.00 before the Oct 30 salary; old-bank items are history only and don't touch it
London is on GMT after Oct 25, so a 7 AM call is 3 PM in her family's city
